pythonFunction.name: create_complaint_case
pythonFunction.description:
Creates a complaint case after an attempt to resolve the issue first, and returns the case
number and the timeline to share. Needs an identified caller. Before calling this tool, speak a
brief conversational pacing phrase while it runs.

Args:
    account_id: Leave empty: the identified account is used automatically (any other id is refused).
    type: Complaint category such as billing, service or other (REQUIRED).
    description: What the customer said, in plain words (REQUIRED).
    tenant: Injected by the system from tenant_id; leave empty.

Returns:
    dict with ok, case_number and timeline (from the brand configuration; empty when none is
    configured).
